$comment: REQ-CLS-001, DL-010. Stage 1 of the class chain. Prototype content budget: 3 archetypes covering tank, healer, melee DPS, ranged DPS and hybrid (§139).

archetypes.name: Vanguard
archetypes.description: Front-line hunters who hold ground and absorb what the party cannot avoid.

archetypes.name: Adept
archetypes.description: Students of the arcane arts, equally capable of mending allies or unmaking enemies.

archetypes.name: Ranger
archetypes.description: Skirmishers and marksmen who trade armour for reach, speed and precision.
